title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Be Exacting With Himself and Easy on Everyone Else
caption:
You want grace for your worst Tuesday. Give that same grace to the guy across from you.

Most men run this backwards: sharp with everyone else's mess, soft on their own. Flip it. Run your own sin through the stricter court. Hand him the mercy you'd want for yourself.

Confess your own stuff loud, to a brother who'll hold you to it. If you have to name his, do it to him in private, not in your head all week.

The bar you hold for yourself is the only one that's actually yours to raise.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #humility #grace
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
